anna's.songTitle: In the Aeroplane Over the Sea
anna's.linePrev: There are lights in the clouds
anna's.lineNext: Hear her voice as it's rolling and ringing through me
stanza: There is music that sounds from the street
There are lights in the clouds
Hear her voice as it's rolling and ringing through me
How the notes all bend and reach above the trees

anna's.linePrev: For every day I've ever known
anna's.line: Anna's in the churchyard, she's got no life at all
anna's.lineNext: She's only got these words on a stone
stanza: When I'm dead and buried, I'll take a hard life of tears
For every day I've ever known
Anna's in the churchyard, she's got no life at all
She's only got these words on a stone
